title: Critical SK mixing, relaxation and log-Sobolev exponents
exact_target: For Gaussian SK at $\beta =1$ and each fixed total-variation threshold $\epsilon \in (0,1/2)$, are continuous-time mixing, relaxation and log-Sobolev constants $n^(2/3+o(1))$, while single-site discrete mixing is $n^(5/3+o(1))$, in probability over disorder?
